title: The authorisation adapter maps organisation membership onto scoped access
asA: handler serving a resource that belongs to an organisation
iWant: to call `can(principal, verb, subject)` where the subject carries an `organisationId` and receive a decision that considers organisation membership
soThat: an operator who is admin in one organisation cannot read another organisation's resources by holding a global admin role in Clerk's dashboard

acceptanceCriteria.description: The adapter's `can(principal, verb, subject)` returns `true` only when the mapping table grants the verb to a role the principal holds AND (when the subject carries an `organisationId`) the principal's `organisationIds` array includes that id.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a principal whose `organisationIds` is `['org-A']` and whose `roles` is `['admin']`; a mapping table granting the verb `document.read` to `admin`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the handler calls `can(principal, 'document.read', { organisationId: 'org-A' })` and then `can(principal, 'document.read', { organisationId: 'org-B' })`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the first call returns `true`; the second call returns `false`

acceptanceCriteria.description: When the subject does not carry an `organisationId`, the adapter falls back to role-only evaluation; a role-granted verb succeeds regardless of the principal's organisation membership set.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the same principal and mapping table as AC-9105-1
acceptanceCriteria.then: both calls return `true`; no organisation membership check is performed
